english_fidelity: Work in us renders operare in nobis; full remedy of your mercy preserves plenum remedium tuae miserationis.

Graciously form and sustain us so that we may please you in all things is a defensible clean study rendering: form conveys tales nos esse perfice, sustain supplies the passive foveri with God as agent, graciously carries propitius, and the purpose clause retains sic/ut, tibi, in omnibus and valeamus.
